author: manrigoggs
quote:
30 hours in and the technical side is genuinely impressive. The graphics, animations, sound design, and the living, detailed world are spectacular — Rockstar still knows how to build a city that feels alive.

Everything else is a letdown.

The story is the weakest the series has ever had. The first couple of chapters are just endless drug trafficking runs back and forth with almost no momentum. Half the missions feel like busywork. The only consistently fun activities are the store robberies; everything else is a slog. Compared to the characters we actually remember — Niko, Trevor, Michael, CJ — Jason comes off as a flat, personality-deficient cuck. There’s no edge, no memorable presence, just a bland lead in a game that keeps trying to feel progressive and “modern.”

The selective morality is especially pathetic. You can mow down unlimited cops with zero consequence, but anything involving certain protected groups or protesters is apparently off-limits. It reeks **** made to tick boxes rather than deliver the chaotic, equal-opportunity mayhem GTA used to be known for. At times it feels closer to a dating sim with open-world window dressing than a proper Grand Theft Auto.

Boring main story, watered-down tone, and a protagonist who makes you miss the old psychopaths. Not worth the price if you’re coming for the classic GTA experience.
